<thought>Based on the measured resistances, every node lies on a single linear resistive path between terminals A and B. By ordering the nodes according to their resistance from A, the individual segment resistances are the differences between successive positions. This yields a pure series chain with twelve resistors whose values match all given measurements.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 6.667, "R2": 5.0, "R3": 10.0, "R4": 15.0, "R5": 20.0, "R6": 5.0, "R7": 10.0, "R8": 15.0, "R9": 20.0, "R10": 10.0, "R11": 15.0, "R12": 20.0}, "connections": [["A","X1","R1"], ["X1","N_b1","R2"], ["N_b1","N_b2","R3"], ["N_b2","N_b3","R4"], ["N_b3","X2","R5"], ["X2","N_c1","R6"], ["N_c1","N_c2","R7"], ["N_c2","N_c3","R8"], ["N_c3","X3","R9"], ["X3","N_d1","R10"], ["N_d1","N_d2","R11"], ["N_d2","B","R12"]]}</final_answer>
